TYK2 full-length models

Five models of P29597, 1,187 residues · Cα cartoon trace via 3Dmol.js · drag to rotate, scroll to zoom

Three full-length models. TYK2 has an experimental closed reference — 4OLI, the autoinhibited JH2–JH1 crystal — and the AF3 closed model reproduces it to 2.02 Å JH1 RMSD after superposing JH2. That is a far stronger anchor than JAK2 had, where the only closed reference was a homology model.

Note what the AlphaFold DB model is here. For JAK2 it is open; for TYK2 it is closed (FERM–JH1 39.7 Å, 1.66 Å from the crystal). The default AlphaFold answer is not the same state across the JAK family.

The closed state is solid. The AF3 closed model and the AlphaFold DB model agree with the 4OLI crystal to 2.02 and 1.66 Å respectively, and with each other to 1.77 Å. An experimental structure, an AF3 run and the AFDB model all give the same autoinhibited arrangement.

But the open/closed pair is confounded. The two AF3 models come from different jobs, with different seeds and different template settings (closed: template on; open: template off). They differ in provenance as well as conformation. The FERM domain alone differs by 5.47 Å between them — against 0.10–0.66 Å for every domain across JAK2's five models — so these two structures are not related by a rigid-body motion of JH1 the way JAK2's were. Any ΔΔG difference between them carries that confound.

6. AlphaFold DB PAE

Our OpenFold runs use model_1, which emits no PAE. The AlphaFold DB download includes it, and it is the most important caveat on this page. PAE at (i, j) is the error AlphaFold expects in residue j's position when the prediction is aligned on residue i — so the off-diagonal blocks measure confidence in the relative placement of two domains, which per-residue pLDDT cannot express.

Within domains AlphaFold is confident (2.4–5.4 Å). Between FERM and JH1 it is at 21.0 Å, 68% of the 31 Å ceiling — it has essentially no idea where JH1 sits. That does not invalidate a dual-state ΔΔG, since ΔΔG is local and the domains themselves are confidently modelled, but the interface residues that generate the difference between states are in the least certain part of the model.
